# Citizen Construction Rentals
Website: https://citizenconstructions.com

Citizen Construction Rentals is an aerial work platform (AWP) rental provider operating across India since 2000. We rent brand new CE-certified Straightline electric scissor lifts, Straightline boom lifts, and trusted used JLG and Genie aerial work platforms delivered directly to industrial, logistics, and commercial sites nationwide.

## Rental Fleet
- Brand New Scissor Lifts: https://citizenconstructions.com/brand-new/scissor-lifts
  - Straightline GTJZ06 (6 m nominal, 6 m platform, 8 m working height)
  - Straightline GTJZ08 (8 m nominal, 8 m platform, 10 m working height)
  - Straightline GTJZ10 (10 m nominal, 10 m platform, 12 m working height)
  - Straightline GTJZ12 (12 m nominal, 12 m platform, 13.7 m working height)
  - Straightline GTJZ14 (14 m nominal, 13.7 m platform, 15.7 m working height)
- Brand New Boom Lifts: https://citizenconstructions.com/brand-new/boom-lifts
  - Straightline SL28T (26 m platform, 28 m working height)
  - Straightline Articulating Boom (14 m platform, 16 m working height)
- Used Fleet: https://citizenconstructions.com/used
  - JLG & Genie Scissor Lifts: https://citizenconstructions.com/used/scissor-lifts
  - JLG & Genie Boom Lifts: https://citizenconstructions.com/used/boom-lifts
